context_scope.name: context_scope
context_scope.using:
"audit_entries"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "audit_entries"."person_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.person_id', true), '')::uuid AND
    (("audit_entries"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND
  ("audit_entries"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id', true), '')::uuid OR current_setting('sep.organization_admin', true) = 'true')) OR ("audit_entries"."event_id" IS NULL AND "audit_entries"."action" = 'invitation.accepted' AND EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM organization_invitations i WHERE i.id = "audit_entries"."resource_id" AND i.organization_id = "audit_entries"."organization_id"
        AND i.status = 'accepted' AND i.accepted_by = "audit_entries"."person_id" AND i.token_hash = current_setting('sep.invitation_hash', true))))
context_scope.withCheck:
"audit_entries"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND "audit_entries"."person_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.person_id', true), '')::uuid AND
    (("audit_entries"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.organization_id', true), '')::uuid AND
  ("audit_entries"."event_id" = nullif(current_setting('sep.event_id', true), '')::uuid OR current_setting('sep.organization_admin', true) = 'true')) OR ("audit_entries"."event_id" IS NULL AND "audit_entries"."action" = 'invitation.accepted' AND EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM organization_invitations i WHERE i.id = "audit_entries"."resource_id" AND i.organization_id = "audit_entries"."organization_id"
        AND i.status = 'accepted' AND i.accepted_by = "audit_entries"."person_id" AND i.token_hash = current_setting('sep.invitation_hash', true))))

event_configuration_dates.value: ("event_configurations"."start_date" IS NULL AND "event_configurations"."end_date" IS NULL) OR ("event_configurations"."start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "event_configurations"."end_date" IS NOT NULL AND "event_configurations"."end_date" >= "event_configurations"."start_date")

event_configuration_scheduled_dates.name: event_configuration_scheduled_dates
